publication: Draft follow-up; user approved PR75, not this new change.
purpose: Align article sharing dates/author and actual localized editions with existing JSON-LD; prevent metadata drift in generated output.

initialAudit.escaping: The initial concern about double escaping was disproved by executing the existing serializer: round-trip true, no raw less-than delimiter. Preserve the existing behavior; do not report a security defect or corrupted production data.

scope.dates: Recorded publication and modification values; no new editorial timestamps.
scope.social: Add article:published_time, article:modified_time, article:author and og:site_name. Only actual alternate editions enter og:locale:alternate.
scope.serialization: Move existing HTML-safe JSON-LD serialization into a tested helper without changing its behavior.
scope.guard: Build compares site graph shape, BlogPosting identity/language/headline/description/dates/profile, visible title/dates and social metadata; skips noindex/redirect shells.

review.type: Self AI review, not independent or human review

findings.issue: Article dates and author were present in JSON-LD but absent in article sharing tags.
findings.resolution: Use one article metadata value source for JSON-LD and Open Graph.

findings.issue: A global list of supported languages would advertise translations that do not exist for a specific article.
findings.resolution: Derive og:locale:alternate from that page’s real hreflang editions and exclude current/duplicate locales.

findings.issue: The existing serializer was suspected of double escaping.
findings.resolution: Reproduction showed it was correct. Preserve it and add round-trip and browser DOM regression evidence; no production bug claim.

findings.issue: A raw script-looking sequence can occur safely inside an escaped quoted meta attribute, so source substring tests can give false positives.
findings.resolution: Validate JSON values, escaped visible heading and actual executable script nodes in the browser.

findings.issue: Optional sharing tags and valid structured data do not prove external preview or rank changes.
findings.resolution: Limit claims to metadata consistency; do not promise search ranking, rich results or platform cache refresh.

validation.nodeCases: Safe serialization including closing-script text, all-eight-language author/date fallbacks and only-real locale alternates.
validation.pythonCases: Nine methods cover malformed/duplicate/missing graph, title/language/identity/description drift, duplicate/missing tags, invalid or reversed/naive dates, visible date drift, wrong author/locales, double-escaped values, non-article separation and noindex/redirect/ownership exclusions.
validation.generatedFixture: Temporary English post with special characters and closing-script text; JSON-LD/headline round trip. Test source removed and production output rebuilt.

limits: No social platform cache/preview or external search ranking effect measured.
Open Graph fields added here are optional protocol metadata, not claimed to be Google requirements.
JSON-LD array layout and author fallback rules are site-specific validation policy.
The existing default sharing image is unchanged; no new article image or personal biography is invented.
